verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets developers 'use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform,' a first-party route to natural-language operation through an AI client. The evidence frames it around developers building payment solutions faster rather than operating the platform's own functions (onboarding, splits, payouts) by command, and it does not show which operations are exposed. Missing for 10: documented list of platform operations controllable via natural language, a native in-product natural-language interface, scope and permission details of the MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
